text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pemuliharaan Hidupan Liar

(Musim Terbuka, Kaedah dan Masa Memburu) 2014.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 3 November 2014.

Musim terbuka, kaedah dan masa memburu

2. (1) Musim terbuka, kaedah dan masa memburu hidupan liar yang dilindungi

yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual adalah sebagaimana yang dinyatakan

masing-masing dalam ruang (2), (3) dan (4) Jadual.

(2) Hidupan liar yang dilindungi yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual

boleh diburu di mana-mana kawasan kecuali di kawasan larangan memburu yang

dinyatakan dalam Perintah Pemuliharaan Hidupan Liar (Kawasan Larangan Memburu)

2013 [P.U. (A) 364/2013].

Pembatalan

3. Perintah Perlindungan Hidupan Liar 1972 [P.U. (A) 409/72] dibatalkan.

WILDLIFE CONSERVATION ACT 2010

WILDLIFE CONSERVATION (OPEN SEASON, METHODS AND TIMES OF HUNTING)

ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraphs 35(a), (c) and (d) of the Wildlife

Conservation Act 2010 [Act 716], the Director General, with the approval of the

Minister, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Wildlife Conservation (Open Season,

Methods and Times of Hunting) Order 2014.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 3 November 2014.

Open season, methods and times of hunting

2. (1) Open season, methods and times of hunting of the protected wildlife

specified in column (1) of the Schedule are as specified in columns (2), (3) and (4)

respectively.

(2) The protected wildlife referred to in column (1) of the Schedule may be

hunted in any areas except in the hunting prohibited areas as specified in the Wildlife

Conservation (Hunting Prohibited Areas) Order 2013 [P.U. (A) 364/2013].

Revocation

3. The Wildlife Conservation Order 1972 [P.U. (A) 409/72] is revoked.
